NONE: › a drug that increases the development of your muscles, sometimes taken illegally by people taking part in sports competitions
（可用于促進肌肉生長，有時在體育競賽中被非法使用的藥物）類固醇

I or T: › to (cause to) move quickly in a twisting circular movement
› to cause something to stop working in the usual or expected way

example: A massive tower of smoke roiled skyward.
一個巨大的煙柱翻騰上升著。
Fears about Japan roiled world financial markets last week.
上個星期對日本的擔憂讓世界金融市場停止了正常運作。
The immigration debate has roiled the country for more than a year.
有關移民的辯論讓國家一年多都沒能正常運轉。
